press_references.value: Orange Egypt Partners with eHealth to Accelerate Digital Healthcare Transformation in Egypt

partnership_announcements.description: Orange Egypt signed a strategic partnership with eHealth to co-create integrated digital healthcare systems in Egypt, leveraging Orange’s infrastructure and customer reach with eHealth’s healthcare digital solutions to support a nationwide digital health ecosystem.

press_references.value: Orange Egypt and PARAGON | ADEER Launch AI Campus at Sumou Boulevard to Power Egypt’s Tech Future

partnership_announcements.description: Orange Egypt and Paragon | Adeer signed a strategic MoU, with Plug and Play as a core partner, to develop a large-scale AI Campus at Sumou Boulevard in New Cairo, combining telecom infrastructure, smart urban development, and a global innovation network to support Egypt’s AI ecosystem.

press_references.value: Orange Egypt and GIZ Launch Digital Training Hub Supporting Youth Empowerment

partnership_announcements.description: Orange Egypt, in cooperation with GIZ and in partnership with Aswan University, launched the Orange Digital Center in Aswan as a strategic collaboration to provide free digital skills training and youth empowerment programs in Upper Egypt.

press_references.value: Orange Egypt and Public Prosecution Unveil Integrated Digital Platform for Legal Services

partnership_announcements.description: Orange Egypt and the Egyptian Public Prosecution announced a new phase of their strategic partnership to deliver integrated digital legal and governmental services through the My Orange app and Orange Cash Wallet.

press_references.value: Orange Egypt Unveils Nation’s First Digital Gold Trading Platform via Mobile Wallets

partnership_announcements.description: Orange Egypt announced an exclusive partnership with mnGm to enable Egypt’s first digital gold trading via mobile wallets on the My Orange app and Orange Cash.

press_references.value: Orange Egypt Marks 19 Years of Empowering Youth Through Enactus Sponsorship

partnership_announcements.description: Orange Egypt renewed its long-standing partnership with Enactus Egypt by sponsoring the 2025 Enactus Egypt National Competition, supporting youth entrepreneurship and innovation.

press_references.value: Orange Egypt and Huawei Partner to Launch Energy-Efficient, High-Capacity 5G Network

partnership_announcements.description: Orange Egypt and Huawei have announced a strategic partnership to deploy an energy-efficient, high-capacity 5G network in Egypt, leveraging advanced technologies like Massive MIMO, the '0 Bit 0 Watt' energy platform, and E-band microwave solutions to enhance connectivity and support digital transformation.

press_references.value: Orange Egypt CEO Yasser Shaker showcases national AI vision at Egypt-France Business Forum during President Macron’s state visit to Cairo
